mission: Claim-by-claim evidence-backing audit of the mobile Result surface: trace every visible element to its evidence source and verify it is hidden/uncertain when evidence is absent.

scope.complementTo: e19 resultStateProps.test.ts covers state transitions; this audit covers evidence backing.

configuration.method: static code-path trace per visible element; stored records treated as unvalidated JSON (JSON.parse in strokeResultData.ts), so malformed shapes are runtime-reachable
configuration.datasetScope: none (code audit; no dataset labels touched; held-out cases untouched)

defects.issue: resolutionBasis 'declared' with declaredStroke missing rendered analysis.shotType (or literal 'stroke') under 'You chose this technique.' — fabricated declaration provenance
defects.fix: missing declaration falls back to the no-provenance saved-analysis header

defects.issue: predicted_l3 with predictedStroke.leaf missing rendered analyzed shot as 'Auto-detected by the on-device classifier' — unbacked classifier claim
defects.fix: recorded family label -> family-level framing; no prediction record -> no-provenance header

defects.issue: gated on resultKind === 'scored' only; overallScore null rendered TECHNIQUE SCORE / SCORABLE pill / '—' ring simultaneously with the abstention ledger stating scoring was withheld
defects.fix: new pure gate techniqueScoreSectionVisible (scored AND non-null overallScore) in strokeResultModel.ts, used by ResultScreen

defects.issue: out-of-union resolutionBasis from a corrupt stored row fell off the exhaustive switch, returning undefined and crashing the surface
defects.fix: default case returns the no-provenance header

elementsVerifiedOk: contact marker gate (estimated + confirmation-or-confidence>=0.6 + finite ms)
phase strip (segmented + ordered boundaries; anchor-free never draws a tick)
replay time base (clip/window/phase-extent only; honest empty card otherwise)
one insight (re-derives the same gates; abstention sentence when nothing defensible)
measured rows (each row requires its field; provenance labels match source)
attempt chips (capture-order navigation, never rank; no chips on unknown/solo)
abstention ledger and uncertainty notes (each line mirrors a withheld element)
declared-vs-predicted disagreement line (both fields required; records kept separate)
training states (score + server sync receipt + server plan required)

metrics.mobileTests: npm test: 40 suites passed, 397 tests passed (was 390 before; +7 regression tests in resultEvidenceAudit.test.tsx)
